# Pagination

Pages of a long list: previous, next and page links.

- Status: implemented
- Category: navigation
- Pattern: HTML `<nav aria-label> with links, aria-current=page`
- Text style: `label` (`.nd-text-label`)

## Anatomy

- **previous**: Button-link with the back arrow.
- **pages** (optional): Chips as links; the current one marked.
- **next**: Button-link with the forward arrow.

## Variants

- `numbered`: Page numbers.
- `more`: A "show more" button that appends.

## States

- `default`
- `hover`
- `focus-visible`
- `current`: Chip current marker.
- `disabled`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Through the links. |

## Accessibility

- Role: navigation
- Name: aria-label ("Pages").
- A disabled previous/next control is a non-link or a disabled button, never a live href with aria-disabled alone.
- Loading more keeps the trigger stable; announce the count and offer a way to reach new items. Do not move focus unexpectedly.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (A)
- 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context) (A)
- 2.4.7 Focus Visible (AA)
- 2.4.13 Focus Appearance (AAA)
- 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) (AA)

## Platforms

| Platform | Implementation |
| --- | --- |
| web | nav.nd-pagination with .nd-chip links, or .nd-pagination--more with a button |
| ios | infinite List with a progress row |
| android | LazyColumn paging |
| flutter | ListView with paging |

Web: `.nd-pagination` in kit.css; modifiers `.more`.

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<div class="nd-stack">
  <nav class="nd-pagination" aria-label="Example pages">
    <ul role="list">
      <li>
        <span class="nd-chip" role="link" aria-disabled="true">Previous</span>
      </li>
      <li>
        <a
          class="nd-chip"
          href="#component-pagination"
          aria-label="Page 1"
          aria-current="page"
          >1</a
        >
      </li>
      <li>
        <a class="nd-chip" href="#component-list" aria-label="Page 2">2</a>
      </li>
      <li><a class="nd-chip" href="#component-list">Next</a></li>
    </ul>
  </nav>
  <div class="nd-pagination nd-pagination--more">
    <ul class="nd-list" id="ex-more-list" role="list">
      <li class="nd-list__row">Example item 1</li>
      <li class="nd-list__row">Example item 2</li>
    </ul>
    <button
      class="nd-button nd-button--quiet"
      type="button"
      data-more="ex-more-list"
    >
      Show more examples
    </button>
    <p class="nd-text-caption" id="ex-more-status" role="status"></p>
  </div>
</div>
```
